architecture_principles: a discovered material regularity is only usable inside the chemistry family in which it was measured
a scientific applicability boundary is executable code, not prompt advice
the language model may criticize the rule and may not override it
value of information is computed by a deterministic tool over the admissible set only
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
every gate decision carries a machine-readable reason and is serialized with the run

arm_difference_declaration.forbidden_confound: Hiding applicability information from V5_NO_GATE while showing it to V5_FULL is prohibited by protocol v1.1.
held_identical: model endpoint and stage model assignment
evidence access profile and filtered evidence state
raw assess_shared_shape_applicability outputs for every candidate
the full inadmissible-card list and its machine-readable reasons
VOI implementation, weights and tie epsilon
arm_difference_declaration.information_parity_evidence: build_pre_enforcement_payload() takes no arm argument, and its SHA-256 is written into every run as pre_enforcement_payload_sha256. The two arms must report the same hash.
arm_difference_declaration.only_intended_difference: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI and at freeze
arm_difference_declaration.payload_consequence: Both arms receive the same audit, the same per-candidate applicability outputs and the same inadmissible-card list. V5_NO_GATE marks the audit advisory and keeps every card selectable; V5_FULL marks it binding and removes the inadmissible cards from the ranked set.

candidate_space.rationale: V5 reuses the byte-identical V3/V4 lattice so that the measured change is the chemistry-domain constraint, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> mandatory chemistry-audited local science tool -> deterministic chemistry-domain applicability audit (identical and model-visible in both arms) -> enforcement (V5_FULL only) -> VOI over the selectable set -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze

rules: M-HOLD-120 is admissible: it measures thermal-hold drift directly and does not use the shared thermal-response shape.
M-REPEAT is admissible: it measures realization/state spread directly.
M-SWEEP is admissible: it is the direct verification measurement for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use equal to allowed_with_state_anchor, or when configs/verified_shape_transfer.json records a completed direct sweep for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification. This is deterministic inadmissibility, not a VOI penalty and not prompt advice.

architecture.claim_boundary: V5.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime with a deterministic chemistry-domain admissibility constraint. A V5 result is evidence about executable scientific constraints on measurement choice. It is not a wet-lab result and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.manuscript_boundary: V5 run results must not be written into manuscript/MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_INFORMATION_V5.md until the run series is audited and explicitly frozen by the author.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_CHEMISTRY_GATED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V5
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information or admissibility
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
re-running, rewriting or reinterpreting the frozen V4 series

primary_arms.role: advice-only control isolating the incremental effect of turning identical scientific applicability information into an executable hard constraint
prospective chemistry-aware Agent V5 with executable scientific constraints

architecture.purpose: Test whether an experimentally discovered material regularity and its chemistry-domain boundary can be executed as a hard scientific constraint on which measurement an outcome-blind Agent is allowed to select.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question the next experiment must answer, and request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations
execute read-only scientific tools. The chemistry-audited local rheology summary is mandatory and is forced into the trace whether or not the planner requested it.

deterministic, non-LLM measurement-applicability audit. Computed once per run without reference to the arm, fully visible to the model in both arms, serialized in full, and never produced by a model stage.
V5_FULL only. Converts the identical audit into hard admissibility before VOI ranking and again at freeze. It cannot be overridden by any model stage.
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value from the cards present in the payload
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability and whether its falsification criterion can actually be met
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported weight sensitivity and the strongest objection
commit to one experiment card present in the payload, or abstain, and state its acceptance and falsification criteria
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card. A selection outside the admissible set is rejected at freeze rather than repaired.

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V5 is a new prospective runtime. configs/agent_v4.json, scripts/run_agent_v4.py, prompts/agent_v4_*.txt, src/pur_new/voi.py and every frozen V3/V4 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V5.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards

decision_stability_sent_to_model.evaluated_over: the selectable experiment cards of this arm
decision_stability_sent_to_model.metric_is_not: model confidence; posterior probability; calibrated expected information
decision_stability_sent_to_model.voi_formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Using the measured 120-130 C level change relative to the matched unmodified reactive-core reference, accept a hypothesis only if the result is within 3.4 percentage points of exactly one registered prediction: -42.76% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 17.24% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or -72.76% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. Report the directly measured 120 and 130 C viscosities with the accepted level hypothesis.
judge_normalized.chemistry_support_statement: The primary observable is measured directly across 80-130 C and therefore does not depend on transferring a rheological regularity from another chemistry family. However, S1C41 is resin_modified:ac1920+tk100 and is marked modified_chemistry_unvalidated; consequently, this experiment establishes only the directly observed rheological response of S1C41 and does not validate shared-shape transfer to other modified chemistries. The E_eta descriptor is descriptive and does not establish a molecular mechanism.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured level change differs from -42.76% by more than 3.4 percentage points. H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured level change is at or below -42.76%. H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if the measured level change is at or above -42.76%. If the result is not within 3.4 percentage points of exactly one registered prediction, no single level hypothesis is accepted and the level comparison is unresolved at the stated direct-sweep resolution.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run a direct 80-130 C M-SWEEP on a single-active-axis candidate, with independent preparations and a matched unmodified reactive-core reference, to separate acrylic-like and minor-tackifier-like contributions before attributing the deviation to either axis.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity level change at 120 and 130 C relative to the matched unmodified reactive-core reference, expressed as a percentage, with the full 80-130 C viscosity sweep and descriptive E_eta descriptor.
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C41 is the supported dual-axis intervention region selected by the upstream stages and directly addresses the processing-viscosity failure mode while numerically separating the three registered level predictions. M-SWEEP is preferable to M-ANCHOR because it directly observes 120 and 130 C viscosity in a chemistry whose shared thermal-response shape has not been verified. The result must be interpreted as formulation-level rheological evidence only, not as molecular mechanism or causal attribution of either modifier axis.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I followed the Proposer and Robustness Adjudicator in selecting S1C41::M-SWEEP, and followed the Skeptic by treating the one-repeat 3.4% criterion as vulnerable to realization-state spread and requiring independent preparations and a matched reference in execution. I rejected the deterministic top-tied M-ANCHOR cards despite their higher score because the advisory chemistry audit marks their shared-shape reconstruction as inadmissible before verification, whereas M-SWEEP measures the decision temperatures directly. The audit remains advisory, but its scientific objection is decisive here.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: The candidate chemistry is outside the measured unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI support, and the two modifier axes are changed simultaneously. The experiment cannot separate formulation-family, functionality, region, individual-axis, or interaction effects.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: Low for the primary level at 120 and 130 C because those temperatures are measured directly in the selected sweep; high for any transfer of the observed thermal shape or E_eta descriptor to other resin-modified candidates.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: The direct-sweep discrimination resolution is 3.4 percentage points based on the reported multiplicative fit residual; this is a rheological measurement-plan resolution, not a demonstrated repeatability limit for the modified candidate.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: High and potentially dominant: the local E2 repeatability data show sample CV values of approximately 0.464-0.585 and max/min ratios of 2.80-3.57 across 80-130 C. Independent preparations and matched process-history recording are therefore required before treating a 3.4 percentage-point separation as reliable.

planner.chemistry_support_statement: The local rheological regularities were measured in the original PUR reactive-core formulation family represented by E1-E3, with the E1 +P chemical perturbation treated separately. The intended experiment should stay inside this supported family and avoid introducing AC1920, TK100, or another chemistry-changing modifier unless a chemistry-domain audit establishes support; the experiment should therefore use a direct sweep rather than assume shared-shape transfer across an unsupported chemistry boundary.
planner.failure_mode: The realized processing-viscosity level is not reliably transferable or controllable across preparations, so a modified candidate may fall outside the processing window at 120-130 C.
planner.failure_mode_evidence: E2 temperature-sweep realizations show very large nominal spread at matched temperatures: sample CV is 0.46-0.58 and the max/min ratio is 2.80-3.57 across 80-130 C.
planner.least_resolved_justification: The local hold data contain only two original formulations, E1 and E5, each at 120 C with four points from 15 to 90 min. Their SI_15_to_60 values differ substantially, 0.095 for E1 versus 0.515 for E5, and no hold trajectory is available for E2 or E3 or for the intended modified candidate. By contrast, temperature response has six measured temperatures from 80 to 130 C for E1-E3, although its level is affected by the large repeat spread.
measurement_requirements: Measure the candidate directly from 80 to 130 C in 10 C increments on a freshly prepared sample, including direct observations at 120 and 130 C rather than reconstructing them from a 110 C anchor.
Report the realized viscosity level at each temperature and the apparent temperature-response descriptor from ln(eta) versus 1/T, with at least the catalog-required repeat count.

Compare the measured matched-temperature level with the frozen inert-dilution, associative-elevation, and plasticizing-depression predictions using the declared discrimination resolution; do not infer a molecular mechanism from rheology alone.
Record preparation and process history, and include sufficient repeated preparations to determine whether the observed candidate level is distinguishable from the local realization spread.

If thermal stability is part of the candidate decision, add a matched-window 120 C hold with measurements at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min and at least two independent repeats; do not use the hold trajectory as a substitute for direct processing-window level measurement.
planner.scientific_question: At matched temperature, does the candidate's realized viscosity level follow inert dilution of the reactive mass, rise above that prediction because the acrylic-like modifier is associative, or fall below it because the modifier system is plasticizing? A direct temperature sweep must distinguish at least H-LEVEL-DILUTE from H-LEVEL-ASSOC and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC beyond the declared measurement resolution.

proposer.chemistry_support_assessment: The primary processing-window level is measured directly rather than reconstructed from the unmodified-family shared thermal shape, so the observable remains admissible despite the resin-modified chemistry being outside validated shape-transfer support. The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological and should be interpreted descriptively, not as a molecular activation energy.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: If the directly measured 120-130 C level change relative to the unmodified reactive core falls within the 3.4% direct-sweep resolution of exactly one registered prediction—approximately -42.76% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 17.24% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or -72.76% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC—that hypothesis is supported for S1C41 and the directly measured processing-window level is reported with it.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured level departs from approximately -42.76% by more than 3.4%. H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured level is at or below the inert-dilution prediction, and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above that prediction. A result substantially above dilution supports association; a result substantially below dilution supports plasticization.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A result that does not fall within 3.4% of exactly one prediction is unresolved at the direct-sweep measurement resolution. It would not justify selecting among the three level hypotheses and would indicate that additional replicated or process-state-controlled measurements are needed.

proposer.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity level across 80-130 C, including the realized viscosity at 120 and 130 C, together with the apparent temperature-response descriptor E_eta from ln(eta) versus 1/T.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: Although it is tied at the deterministic VOI maximum and is inexpensive, it reconstructs the 120-130 C level from a 110 C anchor using a shared thermal shape not verified for the resin-modified AC1920/TK100 chemistry. Its observable is therefore conditional on unsupported shape transfer, with 8.8% discrimination resolution.
It directly tests thermal-hold drift but does not return the processing-window level required by the stated failure mode and cannot separate the three registered level hypotheses.

It addresses preparation-to-preparation realization spread but does not directly measure the candidate's processing-window level or discriminate the registered dilution, associative, and plasticizing predictions.

proposer.reasoning: S1C41 lies within the externally supported 15% acrylic-like and 5% minor-tackifier-like intervention regions and addresses all three registered level hypotheses. The direct 80-130 C sweep is preferable to the deterministic top-tied anchor cards because the audit identifies shared-shape transfer as unvalidated for this chemistry. It measures the decision quantity directly, verifies the candidate's thermal response rather than assuming it, and uses the tighter 3.4% direct-sweep resolution.

robustness_adjudication.change_from_proposal: Retain the proposed candidate and direct M-SWEEP, but strengthen execution with multiple independent preparations and a matched unmodified reactive-core reference. Do not use M-ANCHOR or transfer the unmodified-family thermal shape to this resin-modified chemistry.
robustness_adjudication.departure_from_deterministic_ranking: The proposal departs from the deterministic tied top set, which consists of M-ANCHOR cards. This departure is scientifically justified because M-ANCHOR reconstructs the processing-window level through a shared thermal-response shape that has not been verified for the resin_modified:ac1920+tk100 chemistry, whereas M-SWEEP measures 120-130 C directly and verifies the candidate's own thermal response.
residual_decision_risk: The candidate chemistry remains outside the measured chemistry support, so this sweep establishes only the candidate's directly observed response and cannot validate shape transfer to other resin-modified candidates.
Large preparation-to-preparation realization spread may still obscure differences near the registered prediction thresholds.
The dual-axis AC1920/TK100 intervention cannot attribute deviations to acrylic-like association, tackifier plasticization, or their interaction.
A direct level result cannot identify the broader formulation-family, functionality, or region hypotheses.
Thermal-hold drift remains unmeasured for the candidate and is not answered by the sweep.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: The strongest objection is that the proposed one-repeat M-SWEEP cannot credibly support the stated 3.4% discrimination criterion given the E2 realization spread of approximately 46-58% CV and max/min ratios up to 3.57. It does not make M-ANCHOR preferable, because M-ANCHOR additionally relies on unverified shape transfer. The same direct sweep should be run, but with multiple independent preparations and a matched unmodified reactive-core reference before applying the 3.4% criterion. Results should be interpreted as level-hypothesis discrimination only, not as attribution of formulation family, functionality, region, or individual modifier-axis mechanism; E_eta remains descriptive.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: No reported weight perturbation changes the deterministic tied top set: top_experiment_set_stability is 1.0, base_margin_to_first_strictly_lower is 0.002292, and every recommendation_flip_boundary survives the entire 0.5-1.5 sweep. Thus the proposal is not top ranked under any reported weighting; the stable ranking favors M-ANCHOR because the transparent VOI score rewards its lower effort and does not make the advisory chemistry applicability objection binding. Those weightings are defensible as score weightings, but they do not justify using an unsupported shared-shape reconstruction. The tie also leaves the chemistry-support distinction unencoded, providing a scientific reason to prefer direct M-SWEEP.

skeptic.chemistry_domain_support_assessment: The primary 120-130 C level is directly measured by M-SWEEP rather than reconstructed from the unmodified-family shared shape, so the primary observable does not depend on unsupported shape transfer. However, resin_modified:ac1920+tk100 is outside the measured chemistry support, and the fitted E_eta descriptor is not evidence of molecular transfer or mechanism. Independent direct sweeps and replicated preparations are required before any shape-transfer claim is made.
skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The prediction gaps for S1C41 exceed 3.4%, so the hypotheses are numerically separable in an ideal measurement. In practice, the protocol's one freshly prepared sample and min_repeats: 1 do not support 3.4% resolution when the local E2 data show 0.464-0.585 sample CV and up to a 3.57 max/min ratio. Replicated independent preparations and a matched reference are needed for the stated criterion to be credible.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A level result could be incorrectly reported as identifying the broader formulation, functionality, or region hypothesis rather than only discriminating the three registered level predictions for S1C41.
objections.objection: The M-SWEEP predictions for S1C41 are mathematically separated at the declared 3.4% threshold: -42.76% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 17.24% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC, and -72.76% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. However, the experiment does not separate the registered stability hypotheses H1_formulation_family, H2_functionality, and H3_region, which the Proposer correctly lists in hypotheses_not_separated. The level result therefore cannot establish which formulation family, functionality feature, or region caused any observed behavior.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: An above-dilution result could not establish that AC1920 is associative, and a below-dilution result could not establish that the combined modifier system is plasticizing; either result could reflect the unseparated contribution or interaction of both axes.
objections.objection: S1C41 changes both modifier axes simultaneously: AC1920 is 15 wt% and TK100 is 5 wt%, leaving a reactive_mass_fraction of 0.8. Because acrylic_like and minor_tackifier_like loading are not independently varied, the M-SWEEP cannot attribute deviation from the inert-dilution prediction to acrylic association versus tackifier plasticization, nor identify an interaction between them. The registered level alternatives remain numerical aggregate predictions, but mechanism or axis attribution is unavailable.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment may classify random realization displacement as falsification or support of H-LEVEL-DILUTE, H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC, despite the stated criterion being practically unattainable with one freshly prepared sample.
objections.objection: The acceptance and falsification rules use the M-SWEEP discrimination resolution of 3.4%, but the existing E2 repeatability data show sample CV values of 0.464-0.585 and max/min ratios of 2.80-3.57 across 80-130 C, including a 3.57 ratio at 120 C. M-SWEEP has min_repeats: 1 and does not control realization state. Thus the protocol is unlikely to distinguish a 3.4% departure from a prediction from preparation-to-preparation variation. The 3.4% value is a shared-shape fit residual, not demonstrated candidate-level measurement resolution.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A fitted thermal-response slope could be misreported as evidence for a chemical activation energy or molecular association mechanism.
objections.objection: The processing-window viscosity level at 120 and 130 C is directly measured in the M-SWEEP protocol, which is a strength. However, the accompanying E_eta descriptor is obtained by regressing ln(eta) against 1/T and is therefore fit-dependent; it is not a direct molecular observable. The Proposer appropriately says E_eta is descriptive, but any interpretation of it beyond a rheological descriptor would exceed what the protocol measures.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Using the original shared thermal-response shape to interpret or extrapolate this candidate would be unsupported; the direct sweep alone cannot retroactively validate transfer to other resin-modified candidates.
objections.objection: The candidate chemistry family resin_modified:ac1920+tk100 is explicitly marked modified_chemistry_unvalidated, with has_prior_verified_shape_transfer false and shared_shape_use verification_only. The M-SWEEP avoids the invalid M-ANCHOR shortcut by directly measuring 80-130 C, including 120 and 130 C, so the primary level does not reuse the unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI thermal shape. Nevertheless, the candidate remains outside the measured chemistry support; only the direct candidate sweep can establish whether its own response is regular.

skeptic.recommended_change: Retain the direct M-SWEEP rather than M-ANCHOR, but require multiple independent preparations for the candidate and a matched unmodified reactive-core reference under the same recorded process history before applying the 3.4% criterion. Report the result as level-hypothesis discrimination only; use a single-active-axis candidate in a later experiment if attribution of acrylic-like versus tackifier-like effects is required.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The stated 3.4% falsification resolution is not supported by the proposed one-repeat protocol: existing E2 realization spread is approximately 46-58% CV with max/min ratios up to 3.57, while M-SWEEP specifies min_repeats: 1 and does not control process state. The experiment may therefore be unable to produce a result that reliably meets its own discrimination criterion.

tool_trace.name: get_chemistry_audited_rheology_summary
tool_trace.reason: The audited upstream material structure and chemistry-supported local rheology must be loaded before candidate or experiment ranking and before using any shared thermal-response regularity.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The verified E1 +P phosphoric-acid perturbation is excluded from the primary same-composition fit and is interpreted separately as a chemical-perturbation check.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.
Keep deliberately chemistry-perturbed curves outside same-composition fitting, but use them to test whether an intervention shifts viscosity scale, thermal-response shape, or both.

chemical_perturbation_check.interpretation: The verified low-dose H3PO4 perturbation shifts the observed viscosity level while remaining closely compatible with the local shared thermal-response geometry. It is a separate chemical-perturbation check and is not pooled into the primary same-composition state model.

observational_E1_GJJ_day1_comparator.interpretation_boundary: Observational reference only; the compact record does not establish a paired parent-batch relationship between E1 +P and E1 GJJ day-1.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.
experiment_design_implications.verified_acid_perturbation: E1 +P received 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution during dehydration. Its close agreement with the primary shared thermal shape makes it useful as a defined scale-versus-shape perturbation check, not as another nominal E1 realization.

provenance_audit.reason: E1 +P is a verified chemical perturbation: 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution was added during dehydration. It is excluded from the same-composition primary state model and exposed separately as a perturbation check.

tool_trace.name: get_candidate_hypothesis
tool_trace.reason: Return the evidence-derived candidate-space and modifier-axis hypotheses needed to interpret a direct level measurement against the registered dilution, associative, and plasticizing alternatives.

evidence: PAT_US20160215185A1: repeated acrylic tackifying resin examples at approximately 19-20% of total formulation
PAT_US6465104B1 Example 10: 25 wt% low-OH acrylic copolymer with direct 121 C viscosity-stability data
PAPER_CN_ADHESIVES_2025_34_09_54: reports a 15% preferred acrylic-resin addition level, retained as directional lower-bound evidence until its fraction denominator is reverified
acrylic_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 20 and 25% are directly commensurate coarse anchors in the current curated record. The 15% grid level is retained as a lower-bound design point, but the literature denominator for the reported 15% addition level is not treated as an exact total-formulation anchor until reverified.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

local_reactive_core_anchor.reason: E2 is the geometric centre of the original five-point local design: 50/50 PPG2000/PDP-70 and NCO:OH=1.80, centered between E1/E3 stoichiometric perturbations and E4/E5 composition perturbations.
local_reactive_core_anchor.stoichiometry_note: The E2 NCO:OH=1.80 label applies to the original reactive core. If a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group, true stoichiometry must be recalculated from verified material specifications.

stability_hypotheses.H1_formulation_family: Partial replacement of the reactive-only formulation by an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like resin can reduce hot-hold viscosity drift under matched process conditions.
stability_hypotheses.H2_functionality: At comparable acrylic loading, lower effective reactive-group density or lower-OH acrylic chemistry is expected to be more favorable for hot-hold viscosity stability than more highly reactive acrylic chemistry.
stability_hypotheses.H3_region: A useful candidate region is expected within the externally supported coarse space spanned by 15-25% acrylic-like modifier and 0-10% minor tackifier-like modifier, while preserving the relative E2 reactive-core proportions.

chemistry_applicability_audit.enforcement_note: In this condition the chemistry applicability audit is ADVISORY. Every experiment card above remains selectable, including the cards the audit marks inadmissible. Use the audit as scientific evidence and justify whatever you select.
rule_text: Scope: measurement admissibility, not formulation admissibility.
M-HOLD-120, M-REPEAT and M-SWEEP observe their quantity directly and remain admissible.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use == 'allowed_with_state_anchor', or when a versioned prior direct sweep has verified transferability for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification: the one-point anchor would reconstruct 120-130 C viscosity through a shape that has never been measured for that chemistry.
This audit is a deterministic scientific rule, not a VOI penalty and not a model opinion. Whether it is binding in this run is stated by the enforcement field.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
voi.tie_note: These experiments share an identical component vector. The deterministic tool is indifferent among them. Any choice within this set must be justified scientifically.

top_cards.required_precondition: a completed direct M-SWEEP on this chemistry family, recorded in configs/verified_shape_transfer.json

top_cards.acceptance_criterion: The measured 120-130 C level change against the unmodified reactive core falls within 8.80% of exactly one registered prediction: -55.24% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 24.76% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC or -95.00% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. That hypothesis is accepted for this composition and the processing-window level is reported with it.
top_cards.admissibility_reason: M-ANCHOR reconstructs the 120-130 C response through the shared thermal-response shape. That shape has not been measured for chemistry family resin_modified:ac1920+tk100 (applicability status modified_chemistry_unvalidated), and no versioned prior direct sweep has verified its transfer.

budget_efficiency_detail.definition: 1 - effort_points / max(effort_points) over the declared catalog

top_cards.falsification_criterion: H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured level change is at or below the inert-dilution prediction of -55.24%. H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above that same prediction. H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured level change departs from -55.24% by more than the 8.80% resolution of this plan.
